issues.description: The template's Bitmap24.hpp declares save(...) and set(...) as private, but main.cpp calls bitmap.set(...) and bitmap.save(...). The solution's Bitmap24.hpp exposes these methods as public. This visibility mismatch in the template will cause compilation errors and prevents students from building and running the provided example program.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the access specifier for save(const std::string&) and set(...) in example_program/src/Bitmap24.hpp in the template repository from private to public so that main.cpp can call bitmap.set(...) and bitmap.save(...). This aligns the template with the solution and allows the example program to compile.
